Joshua S. Johnson  joshjohnson@velaw.com 

Tel +1.202.639.6623  Fax +1.202.879.8934 

July 2, 2019 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re: 

State of Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, Inc., No. 18-1150 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I  represent petitioners in the above-referenced case, in which the petition for a writ of certiorari 
was granted  on  June  24, 2019.  I  have  consulted  with  respondent's counsel  of record,  Eric  F.  Citron, 
regarding the briefing schedule in this matter.  On behalf of both parties, I  respectfully request pursuant 
to  Rule  30.4  that the  Court  grant  an extension of time  for  filing the  briefs on the  merits and  the joint 
appendix in this case, as follows: 

Petitioners' brief on the merits and joint appendix: 

August 23, 2019 

Respondent's brief on the merits: 

October 9, 2019 

If those extensions are granted, petitioners' reply brief would be due by November 8, 2019. 

The  parties  have  agreed  to  the  requested  schedule,  which  would  allow  the  case  to  be  set  for 
argument during the December sitting.  The extensions are requested because of scheduling difficulties 
and the press of other matters. 

Sincerely, 

Joshua S. Johnson
